title: andrzejczaklight
body:
_andrzejczaklight_ is a thoughtfully optimized modpack based on [andrzejczakpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/andrzejczakpack)

## **List of features**

<details>
<summary>Optimization</summary>

[BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations) by thosea - lightmap updates, debug logic, sky color calculation\
[Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities) by cseden - block entities rendering\
[Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) by ishland - chunk generation\
[Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) by juliand665 - background framerate\
[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) by tr7zw - not visible entities rendering\
[Fast Noise](https://modrinth.com/mod/zfastnoise) by ZenXArch - world generation\
[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) by malte0811 - memory usage\
[ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) by RaphiMC - immediate mode rendering\
[Ixeris](https://modrinth.com/mod/ixeris) by decce6 - event polling\
[Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton) by astei - multiplayer networking stack\
[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) by jellysquid3 - game logic\
[ModernFix-mVUS](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix-mvus) by Coredex - game launch, memory usage\
[More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling) by FX - not visible things other than entities rendering\
[ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux) by ishland - light updates\
[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) by jellysquid3 - game rendering\
[ThreadTweak](https://modrinth.com/mod/threadtweak) by getchoo - thread scheduling\
[Very Many Players (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/vmp-fabric) by ishland - game simulation, multiplayer high player count

</details>

<details>
<summary>Framework</summary>

[Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) by shedaniel - More Culling dependency\
[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) by modmuss50 - most mods dependency

</details>

## **Installation**

<details>
<summary>Automatic</summary>

In the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app), [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org), or [ATLauncher](https://atlauncher.com), there should be added a new instance with the downloaded mrpack file imported. If the version is not detected, 1.21.11 with the most recent version of Fabric mod loader must be used

</details>

<details>
<summary>Manual</summary>

First, downloaded mrpack file needs to be converted to zip using an [external tool](https://jamie.codeberg.page/mrpack-to-zip). If it has never been done, [Fabric installer](https://fabricmc.net) must be downloaded and ran with the most recent loader version for 1.21.11 chosen. After that a new instance should have been created in the game launcher

Next - inside .minecraft in the %appdata% file directory in Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft in macOS, or ~/.minecraft in Linux - config, mods, resourcepacks, shaderpacks, and options.txt (provided they exist) have to be removed and then replaced with the contents of the zip file

</details>
